{{Top|leg}}
The '''Great Duinarbulon Mausoleum''' was a site of great historical importance that was discovered by the historian [[Henrietya Antilles]] during the time of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], presumably on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Duinarbulon]]. It contained a number of tomes and documents, such as the [[Antilles Map]], which Antilles deciphered.
